humanities.label: Humanities · sources and interpretation
humanities.scope: the same passage, edition and period
humanities.method: Compare provenance, editions and the independence of accounts.

social.label: Social sciences · methods and populations
social.scope: the same question, population and time window
social.method: Distinguish the population studied, sampling decisions and independent evidence.

computing.label: Computing and mathematics · models and evaluation
computing.scope: the same task, metric and evaluation population
computing.method: Check evaluation conditions, shared data and the limits of generalisation.

engineering.label: Engineering · measurement and design
engineering.scope: the same operating range and measurement units
engineering.method: Compare measurement provenance, operating conditions and reproducible checks.

science.label: Natural sciences · experiments and reproducibility
science.scope: the same procedure, conditions and measured quantity
science.method: Separate observations, transformations, replication and claims beyond the experiment.

business.label: Business and policy · decisions and assumptions
business.scope: the same service, accounting period and cost definition
business.method: Expose decision assumptions, comparison boundaries and the evidence needed to act.

researcher.label: Researcher skills · integrity and open research
researcher.scope: the same dataset, version and reported claim
researcher.method: Trace provenance, compare independent records, consider honest explanations and communicate uncertainty.
